note: EXAMPLE of the contribution ledger. Every locator exists in examples/input/manuscript.md; result evidence repeats a sentence from the manuscript verbatim.

contributions.text: A selection-before-pretraining pipeline that ranks molecules by coverage in a spectral embedding and pretrains only on the coreset.

evidence.claim_in_source: A greedy coverage score then selects molecules that maximise the distance to the already-selected set

scope.stated_limits: no theoretical guarantee for the coverage score

contributions.text: At 100 labels per dataset the pipeline improves accuracy by 11.3% over the strongest self-supervised baseline and reduces pretraining cost by 62.4%.

evidence.claim_in_source: GCP reaches 0.742 on ESOL, 0.781 on Tox21 and 0.704 on the kinase panel
improves accuracy by 11.3% over the strongest self-supervised baseline and reduces pretraining cost by 62.4%
Pretraining cost falls from 41 GPU-hours to 15.4 GPU-hours

scope.stated_limits: three datasets only, one of them proprietary

contributions.text: An attribution of the gain to the coverage score rather than to the self-supervised objective.

evidence.claim_in_source: Removing the coverage score and selecting uniformly drops accuracy by 6.8%, while removing masked bond prediction costs only 1.4%

scope.stated_limits: single ablation study on three datasets
scope.not_claimed: a causal decomposition of every design choice

contributions.text: A coreset-budget sweep that locates the regime in which selection stops paying.

evidence.claim_in_source: at a 20% budget the gap narrows to 3.1%
